title: NO KINGS! National Day of Mobilization Hyannis
description:
We the people say NO KINGS! National, peaceful day of defiance 
We are the many, they are the few. 

Date: Saturday, June 14th
Time: 4:00PM-5:30PM
Location: Hyannis Airport Rotary (details about parking and where exactly to stand listed below.) 
Bring: signs, flag cowbells, drums, and a loud voice for chants! Anyone can feel free to bring instruments, sing, start a chant, this is a movement by the people!

We protest  the executive overreach, court defiance, disappearance of innocent people, the use of funds for a military parade while cutting SNAP medicaid and social security, an unconstitutional attempt at a third term, and slashing services of the people to make the billionaires even richer.

**Keep an eye out for possible special guests, founding fathers & tyrant kings!**

As always, please bring signs, flags, drums, other instruments, chants, art, etc., as joy is resistance, art is resistance, community is resistance. 
[Joyful community resistance to fascism]

******Corruption Destroys, Community Builds: We will be collecting personal care items and/or nonperishable food items to be donated to the Harbor Community Health Center in Hyannis.******

*A core principle behind all No Kings events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values.*
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

**In America, we don’t put up with would-be kings.**
NO KINGS is a national day of action and mass mobilization in response to increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption from Trump and his allies. We’ve watched as they’ve cracked down on free speech, detained people for their political views, threatened to deport American citizens, and defied the courts. They’ve done this all while continuing to serve and enrich their billionaire allies.


🚨**On Saturday, June 14, we’re taking to the streets nationwide. We’re not gathering to feed his ego. We’re building a movement that leaves him behind.**🚨


The flag doesn’t belong to Donald Trump. It belongs to us. We’re not watching history happen. We’re making it.


**On June 14th, we’re showing up everywhere he isn’t—to say no thrones, no crowns, no kings.**
Check out (nokings.org) for more information.

* **He’s using OUR tax dollars to pay for HIS party.** Donald Trump’s birthday celebration is expected to cost millions of our tax dollars, all while Republicans claim there’s no money for Social Security, SNAP, or Medicaid.


* **We are united against kings.** Trump has already indicated that he’s aiming for at least a third term, and now he’s planning a self-aggrandizing military parade in D.C. *But the American people don’t put up with kings.* Together, we will mobilize in huge numbers to reject this corruption and abuse of power—*it’s in our DNA as a country.*

* **They've gone too far.** This is bigger than political disagreement. They’ve defied our courts, deported American citizens, disappeared people off the streets, and slashed our services—all while orchestrating a massive giveaway to their billionaire allies. *Enough is enough.* For anyone who thinks he’s gone too far, this movement is for you.

* **The Army’s birthday isn’t about parades or pageantry — it marks the beginning of America’s rejection of kings.** On June 14, 1775, the Continental Congress created the U.S. Army to stand up against a monarch who claimed absolute power. 250 years later, Donald Trump wants to twist that legacy into a personal celebration of himself.

* **That’s why we say: No Thrones. No Crowns. No Kings.** No Kings is about defending the ideals they fought for. This country doesn’t belong to strongmen. It belongs to the people.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

As with every protest, we want to highlight the extreme unconstitutional practices of this administration, as this is not just about policies. 

This is NOT business as usual in DC, this is NOT normal. 

This republican administration has attempted to seize control over state election processes through executive orders and efforts to undermine civil rights legislation, as well as threatening the checks and balances established by the Constitution, such as disregarding court orders and altering federal regulations without proper authority.​​ The administration is using its current power to help billionaires continue to profit while striping away the services that help the most needy. 

We need to stand up for due process, free speech, upholding court rulings, and the separation of church and state. The Founding Fathers established the principles of due process, free speech, and the separation of church and state through the First Amendment and other parts of the Constitution. These concepts were designed to protect individual rights and limit government power. 

We have NO KINGS in America, yet Trump is acting like one. 

We, the people, must rise up, and show that the power of the people is greater than the people in power.

title: NO KINGS Chelsea, MI
description:
No Kings Day of Action:

title: Rush-hour Resistance Rally @ Moon Valley in North Central Phoenix
description:
Big events with thousands of people are great. But we also need local, more frequent rallies that show locals that they're not alone in this fight.
 
[So we made one](https://www.mobilize.us/indivisible/event/775717). And six weeks later, we've made a second one, and you're invited to attend!

Every Wednesday, @ 7:30 am, we'll gather at Serafina Coffee Roasters on 7th St & Coral Gables to grab a beverage, walk across the parking lot to the sidewalk, and show the busy morning commuters that they are not alone.

Peak traffic time seems to be from 7:45 to 8:30a. Yes, it's already hot in Phoenix, so plan accordingly. 

Spread the word. Come join us. Or start your own!

All the details you need are at [RhRR.us](https://rhrr.us).

Love this idea and [want to start your own Rush-hour Resistance Rally in your area](https://rhrr.us/#start-your-own)? Groovy! Let's make that happen!

title: NO KINGS Woodstock
description:
Trump wants a military parade. We’re giving him a history lesson.

On June 14, while Trump spends millions of taxpayer dollars celebrating his own birthday with tanks and pageantry, Indivisible Woodstock CAN will join communities across the country for No Kings—a national day of action against authoritarianism and billionaire corruption.

Flag Day isn’t about glorifying a man. It marks the birth of the U.S. Army—the day our nation first stood up to a king. Now Trump wants to twist that legacy into a monument to himself. We’re here to say: No Thrones. No Crowns. No Kings.

✊ WHY WE’RE MOBILIZING
This isn’t just political disagreement. It’s a coordinated power grab.

He’s using our tax dollars to throw his party—while they slash Social Security and gut Medicaid.

He’s defied courts, disappeared people, and threatened dissenters.

He’s pushing for a third term and building a machine to rule, not govern.

We’re done being quiet. We’re done pretending this is normal.
This is our country, and we’re showing up to defend it.

🎖️ WHO THIS IS FOR
Whether you’re a veteran who took the oath…
A parent worried about your child’s future…
Or a neighbor who just knows this isn’t right…

This moment is for you.
Come stand with us in visible, nonviolent resistance. Let’s show the country what real patriotism looks like.

🔔 WHAT TO EXPECT
Peaceful rally and sidewalk demonstration—we’ll stay on sidewalks and paved areas and will not block traffic or pedestrians.

Speakers including veterans and community members

A first aid/shade tent nearby

Signs, chants, flags, and a united front against corruption

🧭 WHAT TO BRING & WEAR
Wear red, white, and blue

If you’ve served or are currently serving, feel free to wear military attire

Bring water, sunscreen, and a sign if you’ve got one

🛡️ OUR COMMUNITY GUIDELINES
Stay peaceful and nonviolent

Do not bring weapons (even legally permitted ones)

Do not engage with agitators or counter-protesters

Follow the lead of our trained volunteers and coordinators

Keep public areas accessible and safe for all

This is a nationwide mobilization to reject strongman rule and stand up for the people. We’re not spectators. We’re the story.


HOSTED BY:
Indivisible Woodstock CAN
📧 woodstockcan@proton.me
📣 Instagram: @indivisiblewoodstockcan
🌐 www.woodstockcan.com

title: NO KINGS Escondido, CA
description:
**In America, we don’t put up with would-be kings.**
A coalition of citizens advocate groups including We the People, Red Wine and Blue, Indivisible North County San Diego, and 50501 Escondido are proud to collaborate for a rally in Grape Day Park, followed by a march through downtown Escondido in solidarity with the national No Kings day of action.

Communities across the nation are under attack from the unlawful and unconstitutional overreach by the executive branch and related federal agencies, including here in San Diego and Escondido.  People's constitutional rights to due process, habeas corpus, protection from search and seizure are being violated as DHS and ICE continue to harass legal residents, U.S. citizens, and undocumented immigrants alike. We the public reject their authoritarian and unlawful overreach, and stand up to protect our fellow Americans.

## Event Schedule & Activities
**10:00 AM - Rally Begins at Grape Day Park**

Speakers, local community leaders, and organizations will highlight issues and concerns, with a focus on how attempts to violate people's rights to due process, habeas corpus, and illegal detention are impacting our immigrant community

Speakers and content will be translated in both English and Spanish

**Following Speakers - March Through Downtown Escondido**

After speakers, the community members will march through downtown Escondido, before circling back and ending up back at the park

**Back at Grape Day Park - Community Resource Fair**

After the march, local non-profits and other community support organizations will have tables for attendees to:

- Learn how to get involved and volunteer or support the community and these local organizations

- Discover and request available resources, connect with community support networks


## Why We March
**NO KINGS is a national day of action and mass mobilization in response to increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption of the Trump administration. We’ve watched as they’ve cracked down on free speech, detained people for their political views, threatened to deport American citizens, and defied the courts. They’ve done this all while continuing to serve and enrich their billionaire allies.


🚨**On Saturday, June 14, we’re taking to the streets nationwide. We’re not gathering to feed his ego. We’re building a movement that leaves him behind.**🚨


**He's using OUR tax dollars to pay for HIS party.** Donald Trump's birthday celebration is expected to cost millions of our tax dollars, all while Republicans claim there's no money for Social Security, SNAP, or Medicaid.


**We are united against kings.** Trump has already indicated that he's aiming for at least a third term, and now he's planning a self-aggrandizing military parade in D.C. But the American people don't put up with kings. Together, we will mobilize in huge numbers to reject this corruption and abuse of power—it's in our DNA as a country.


**They've gone too far.** This is bigger than political disagreement. They've defied our courts, deported American citizens, disappeared people off the streets, and slashed our services—all while orchestrating a massive giveaway to their billionaire allies. Enough is enough.


The flag doesn’t belong to Donald Trump. It belongs to us. We’re not watching history happen. We’re making it.


**On June 14th, we’re showing up everywhere he isn’t—to say no thrones, no crowns, no kings.**
Check out nokings.org for more information.

And not just any movement - in Roanoke we’re inviting you to come together to build community, in joyful, musical, art and family-filled rebellion, standing in solidarity to demand a government and economy that ensures access to opportunity and a better life for all of us.

## What to bring

Bring picnic blankets, instruments, art (think Daisy Art Parade big!), bubble machines, family, pets, etc. There will be live music, performance artists, and more. This is about coming together as a community, showing our numbers, and building the strength of our movement through deeper connection to one another.

## Location
2020 Andrews Rd NW, Roanoke, VA 24017

title: Rush-hour Resistance Rally @ ICE Field Office in Phoenix
description:
Big events with thousands of people are great. But we also need local, more frequent rallies that show locals that they're not alone in this fight.

So we made one. And six weeks later, we have three, and you're invited to attend!

Every Thursday, @ 7 am, we'll gather on the north east corner of Central and Monte Vista, right in front of the ICE Field office. 

STAY ON THE SIDEWALK! It's public property and we've a right to be there. Be sure you DO NOT BLOCK access to the building—that means cars as well as people.

*Please make ICE-specific signs, as we're here to show the busy morning commuters that they are not alone and the ICE staffers that We The People care about due process for everyone.*

Spread the word. Come join us. Or start your own!

All the details you need are at [RhRR.us](https://rhrr.us).

Love this idea and want to start your own Rush-hour Resistance Rally in your area? Groovy! [Let's make that happen!](https://rhrr.us/#start-your-own)

title: Protest to Support our LGBTQ+ Community
description:
This a local Indivisible event!
Protest to Support our LGBTQ+ Community

Date: Sunday, June 22nd 
Time: 4:00PM-5:30PM
Location: Hyannis Airport Rotary (details about parking and where exactly to stand listed below.) 
Please wear “pride spirit” to make a visual impact as a rainbow sea of love, acceptance, and appreciation for diversity and all the unique talents that makes our community so vibrant. 
As always, please bring signs, flags, drums, other instruments, chants, art, etc., as joy is resistance, art is resistance, community is resistance. [Joyful community resistance to fascism]

In honor/celebration of pride month, we are protesting against Trump & his administration, specifically against the harm he has caused to the LGBTQ+ community. We are infuriated with his executive orders that ban gender affirming care for minors, that restrict trans rights, and that eliminate protections against discrimination for those in the LGBTQ+ community. We recognize the detrimental effect this has had on the well being of many individuals and the community as a whole. We stand in solidarity to say we will not put up with this.
We will not allow this administration’s attacks on the LGBTQ+ community to continue! #RESIST
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

******Corruption destroys, Community Builds: We will also be collecting nonperishable food items for the AIDS support group in Hyannis. ******

We are being cosponsored by a local pride group, and have invited local pride groups to set up informational tables if they are available. 

As with every protest, we also want to highlight the extreme unconstitutional practices of this administration, as this is not just about policies. 
This is NOT business as usual in DC, this is NOT normal. 

This republican administration has attempted to seize control over state election processes through executive orders and efforts to undermine civil rights legislation, as well as threatening the checks and balances established by the Constitution, such as disregarding court orders and altering federal regulations without proper authority.​​ The administration is using its current power to help billionaires continue to profit while striping away the services that help the most needy. 

We need to stand up for due process, free speech, upholding court rulings, and the separation of church and state. The Founding Fathers established the principles of due process, free speech, and the separation of church and state through the First Amendment and other parts of the Constitution. These concepts were designed to protect individual rights and limit government power. 
We have NO KINGS in America, yet Trump is acting like one. 
We, the people, must rise up, and show that the power of the people is greater than the people in power. 

Protest Homework (aka, protest action steps)
5 Calls App or Website, National Action Steps:
Scroll down to the LGBTQ+ section, as of right now there are 2 calls to make (to all 3 of your members of congress!):
1. *“condemn RFK Jr’s False Report on Transgender Youth Treatment” and 
2. *“Oppose Efforts to Dehumanize transgender and LGBTQ+ people” 
If you have time for another round of calls, please scroll to “executive overreach” and click:
3. *”fight the trump administration’s defiance of the constitution and courts”

address_lines: Intersection of Silver St. and Leyden Rd, Greenfield, MA

description:
Stand up for democracy with Franklin County neighbors and people up and down the Valley! Hundreds of us will stand with banners and signs on seven I-91 overpasses in Franklin County at the same time that people stand out on I-91 overpasses from Connecticut up to Vermont. We’ll be visible to thousands of people driving on I-91 during the Friday evening commute and the beginning of Memorial Day weekend.

Franklin County’s I-91 overpass standouts are being organized by Franklin County Continuing the Political Revolution (FCCPR), Indivisible West Quabbin and Gill Indivisible. We The People stand to raise awareness about attacks on our society by the Trump administration.

We The People stand to:

•Save the Constitution •Save Medicare •Save Medicaid •Save Social Security •Save Veteran’s Services •Save funding to universities and non-profits •Save the Department of Education •Save EPA •Save NOAA •Save libraries •Save Head Start •Stop ICE from kidnapping people •Stop attacks on free speech •Stop the othering of the queer/transgender community

We stand to RESIST!

Bring signs and banners with LARGE BOLD messages so they can be read by drivers on I-91.

This action is legal and nonviolent. Safety is essential… take care with parking and walking to/from the overpass and during the standout.  Parking is available on Place Terrace St. and the Academy of Early Learning on Place Terrace.  If more parking is needed, please park at the bottom of Nash's Mill Rd.

title: NO KINGS Milpitas
description:
Wannabe king/dictator Donald Trump is throwing himself a birthday celebration that’s expected to cost tens of millions of our tax dollars, all while Republicans claim there’s no money for Social Security, SNAP, or Medicaid.  That same day, we will rally to oppose his corruption, illegal activities, and violation of the basis of our democracy – the U. S. Constitution – to which all veterans swear an oath to uphold.

### The Milpitas rally will be Saturday, June 14 from 10:00 AM till noon in front of City Hall. 

## Sign Up to join us and get updates!

This country doesn’t belong to a king—and we’re not letting a wannabe king throw himself a taxpayer-funded parade while slashing both our civil rights and the programs our families and communities depend on. No Kings is a nationwide day of defiance to reject authoritarianism—and show the world what democracy really looks like.

The Army’s birthday isn’t about parades or pageantry — it marks the beginning of America’s rejection of kings.  On June 14, 1775, the Continental Congress created the U.S. Army to oppose a monarch who claimed absolute power. Now, 250 years later, Donald Trump wants to twist that legacy into a personal celebration of himself – yet another example of him corrupting our government.

On June 14th, we’re showing up everywhere he isn’t—to say no thrones, no crowns, no kings. Using the principles of nonviolence and peaceful protest, we will stand together to oppose any king wannabe.

**No Kings Day in cities across the country!**  See the map: [https://www.mobilize.us/nokings/map/](https://www.mobilize.us/nokings/map/)

### No Thrones. No Crowns. No Kings.

In Milpitas, we are standing for democracy, the U. S. Constitution, and the rule of law. 

Even if you cannot attend, use your social media and email lists to spread the word. Find graphics [here](https://brandfolder.com/s/vqbb79z4p6hhkgkrxwp9nh). 

Remember to bring noise-makers: drums, cowbells, whistles, and empty soda cans filled with beans/pebbles!

**50501 is a peaceful movement.  Violence of any kind will not be tolerated.**

title: NO KINGS! National Day of Defiance
description:
Donald Trump thinks his rule is absolute, but in America, we don’t do “kings.” Since the inauguration, the Trump administration and its enablers have operated as though they have a mandate—but they don’t, and never did. They are going to extremes to empower Trump and enrich themselves, while cutting jobs and services for the rest of us. Now, they’re turning Flag Day into a celebration of Trump.

💰 He’s using OUR tax dollars to pay for HIS party: Donald Trump’s birthday celebration is expected to cost millions of our tax dollars, all while Republicans claim there’s no money for Social Security, SNAP, or Medicaid.

👑 We are united against kings: Trump has already indicated that he’s aiming for at least a third term, and now he’s planning a self-aggrandizing military parade in D.C But the American people don’t put up with kings. Together, we will mobilize in huge numbers to reject this corruption and abuse of power—it’s in our DNA as a country.

✋ They’ve gone too far: This is bigger than political disagreement. They’ve defied our courts, deported American citizens, disappeared people off the streets, and slashed our services—all while orchestrating a massive giveaway to their billionaire allies. Enough is enough. For anyone who thinks he’s gone too far, this movement is for you.

We’re standing together against the abuses of power, cruelty, and corruption. On June 14, we gather to remind Trump and his enablers: America has No King!

title: No Kings Day Citizens' Parade in Wilmington
description:
Hosted by Indivisible Highlands and Beyond; co-hosted with 302 United and Delaware Working Families Power.

Come out for Wilmington’s "No Kings Citizens' Parade" as part of the June 14th National Day of Defiance to counter Trump's ridiculous $45 million birthday parade in DC on this same day. Join us as we parade down Wilmington's own Pennsylvania Avenue to say "NO KINGS!"

June 14th is Flag Day and also the 250th birthday of the army — a day that marks when Americans first organized to stand up to a king. "Trump isn’t honoring that legacy. He’s hijacking it to celebrate himself."

“This country doesn’t belong to a king — and we’re not letting him throw himself a parade funded by tens of millions of our taxpayer dollars while stealing from us and stripping away our rights, our freedoms, and the programs our families rely on. On June 14th, we’re coming together to send one clear message: No Thrones. No Crowns. No Kings.”

We will gather at the corner of Pennsylvania Avenue and N. Bancroft Parkway in Wilmington. Specifically, we'll meet on grass lawn between the two sides of N. Bancroft Parkway - on the Wawaset Park side of PA Ave., between PA Ave. and W. 11th St. - and march/walk on the sidewalk along Pennsylvania Avenue toward Tower Hill School. 

A short pre-parade rally (with music and guest speakers) will precede the parade. The full roundtrip march is 1.3 miles long.

Bring flags and signs (two-sided, if possible) as well as kazoos, drums, cowbells, etc.

If walking isn't possible for you, please come anyway - with signs and flags - and be part of a Honk and Wave rally along Pennsylvania Ave. 

Parking is available on N. Bancroft Parkway and surrounding streets. (To ensure you arrive in time for the 9 am pre-parade rally, you might want to give yourself extra time to find a spot.)

Given our commitment to nonviolent action, we expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values. If you encounter a heckler or counter-protester (organized or unorganized, from a simple raised finger to a verbal taunt), the rule of thumb is to IGNORE IT!! Do not engage. If necessary, simply turn your back - or walk away.

description:
** Hosted by** 

50501MI with Crowded Table Coalition, Indivisible Michigan 7th District (IMI7), and Ingham County Democratic Party (ICDP)

**Featuring** 

Clean Water Action • Rank MI Vote • Bee Accepting • Lansing for Palestine • No Detention Centers Michigan (NDCM) • Coalition Against Genocide • Michigan Sierra Club • BAMN • Reclaim Project

**With:**

American Families United • Common Defense  • General Strike US • Lansing Queer History Guild • Michigan League of Conservation Voters • Mid-Michigan Tenants Resource Center • Money Out of Politics • MSU Non-Tenured Faculty • Planned Parenthood • Rent is Too Damn High • Refugee Development Center • Stop GEO Group in Baldwin • Women's March


**Event schedule:**

**11 AM - 12 PM:** ICDP Tribute Rally to Ted Lawson 

**12 PM - 2 PM:** 50501MI Rally

**2 PM - 3 PM:** Sidewalk March

**3 PM - 6PM:** No Kings Carnival & Booth Conversations 

**Entire duration of event**: Mutual Aid Drive 


** President Trump thinks his rule is absolute, but in America, we don’t do “kings.” **

On June 14th, we rally to confront the crises fueled by the Trump regime. We're standing together against the abuses of power, cruelty, and corruption. We’re standing together in defense of marginalized communities, and to demand real change. 

Hear powerful speeches about what we’re fighting for and participate in a sidewalk march to show solidarity. After the protest, we’ll turn his birthday into a spectacle of resistance. Join us for a sharp, satirical ‘No Kings’ Carnival that mocks the absurdity and exposes authoritarian excesses. 

**We’re not gathering to feed his ego. We’re building the movement that leaves him behind.**

Turn your back on the military parade — funded with our tax dollars — to empower your community and enjoy satirical games, art, and performances instead.

🥫**Mutual aid drive**: Donate shelf-stable food, hygiene supplies, sexual health supplies, gender-affirming items, first aid supplies, and clothing to empower neighborhoods and promote collective sustainability. Donations will be going to the Detroit Resistance Book Club, General Strike US, Mid-Michigan Tenant Resource Center, Lansing Syringe Access, Women's Center of Greater Lansing, and Salus Center.

** Why we must act**:  To defend immigrant rights, fight for LGBTQIA+ and BIPOC justice, protect reproductive rights, defend disabled people's rights, defend education, healthcare, science, legal, and press institutions, advocate for Palestinians and Ukrainians, protect the environment, and challenge systemic injustices. 

🎪** We are building a broad coalition for a more equitable future.** Whether you're outraged by attacks on civil rights, skyrocketing costs, abductions and disappearances, the gutting of essential services, or the assault on free speech—this moment is for you. Whether you've been in the fight for years or you're just fed up and ready to take action—this moment is for you. 

Be sure to invite your friends! 🛑You have the power to help build a massive, visible, national rejection of this crisis. 

**Want to learn more about 50501MI? Visit our website at https://50501michigan.com**

**Want to join our Discord server? Join us at https://discord.gg/yTjBFnG32d**

title: NO KINGS: A Marin-wide Mobilization: Tam Junction
description:
## Time to Rain on This Wannabe King’s Parade
June 14 is Flag Day and Trump’s birthday—and he’s throwing himself a $45 million military-style birthday bash. With our tax dollars. We say: NO KINGS. YES TO THE PEOPLE.

Join in this **county-wide #NoKings takeover** with 20+ pop-up protests all across Marin. One loud, visible, united stand against Trump’s grift and power grab.

➡️ Check the protest locations and pick yours: [mobilize.us/nokings](https://www.mobilize.us/nokings/?country=US&per_page=25&q=Marin-wide)

## 🪧 What to Bring:
Make your own protest sign:
- Cut a **heart-shaped sign** from poster board (a good size is around 18x24" or larger)
- Write: **“NO KINGS, YES _______”** (Fill in the blank with what you believe in— like democracy, healthcare, education, social security, the law, the people, etc.)

Get bold and creative. This country needs more love for people—not billionaires.

👑 Marin doesn’t kneel.

💖 We rise together.

Bring friends. Show up big on **June 14**. 


_A core principle behind all No Kings events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values. All participants agree to assume 100% responsibility for their own safety, conduct and well-being._

accessibility_notes:
Visitors requiring an accessible entrance to the Roundhouse/State Capitol can be dropped off near the accessible ramp in the visitor parking lot on the east side of the building or use accessible parking in that lot.

The entrance to the visitor parking lot is off Paseo de Peralta, just before the intersection of Paseo de Peralta and Old Santa Fe Trail (directly across the street from Kaune's/the two-way street). There is a drop off section where people hold their signs. There should be a ramp there. If you want to get as close as possible, there is an option to turn left on the side of Roundhouse/State Capitol and you can pull up to the curb at the crosswalk where a ramp is located.

There is also an accessible entrance to the Roundhouse/State Capitol through "Capitol North" on Don Gaspar Avenue (the one-way street). Follow the blue accessibility signs to the ramp and to the accessible entrance. This option will not accommodate someone with limited mobility who needs direct access and requires a shorter distance.

Physical Address: 490 Old Santa Fe Trail, Santa Fe, NM 87501
Free parking is available Monday through Friday at 420 Galisteo St.

Helpful links:
https://santafe.com/getting-here/ 
https://www.nmlegis.gov/visitors

title: We the People -- No Kings! Mass Protest
description:
This a local Indivisible event. Florence Indivisible will join a nationwide mass protest of Trump’s Washington D.C. parade.

Rise with us in Florence for Indivisible’s nationwide No Kings! Mass Protest to make clear that under the U.S. Constitution the People Have the Power and we won’t let an abusive and corrupt would-be king sell us out and rob us blind.

The guy who wants a palace in the sky wants to take away our health care and rip away the social safety net that millions—-valiant veterans, tiny infants, hungry kids, workers down on their luck, and seniors who need a helping hand these days after spending lifetimes in service to others—depend on for their survival. 

To would-be kings we say: No Abductions! No Bribes! No Usurpation of Human Rights!

Instead the people affirm we want:  Peace and Prosperity. Greater Access to Economic Success. A Quality Education. Affordable Health Care. Breathable Air. Water Safe Enough to Drink. Economic Stability and Growth for All. 

Enough with the Crazy and Corrupt!

Our message is “We the People! No Kings!” We have cause to oppose the overreach of a would-be authoritarian and his regime. We have a strong case to demand better for ourselves—our neighbors, families, children, grandchildren, our planet!—all of it spelled out clearly in the Bill of Rights and U.S. Constitution. There will be a better day and we will hold accountable those who violate their oaths of office, ignore the courts, scoff at the law, and take from folks living day-to-day on what they can barely scrape together, all to further add to their enormous fortunes.

We will chant and sing out our values, vision for better lives and times, love and patriotism for America and democracy. We’ll stand for who are with signs and flags. No Crowns. No Thrones. No Kings! We the People Means Everyone, Hate Won’t Make US GREAT! Kindness Matters. PEACE, PRIDE, #LOVE Wins!

Let’s rise up across the land to let corrupt and lawless leaders know We the People have the power and we will not abide mad kings.

A core principle behind all No Kings events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values and to act lawfully at these events. Weapons of any kind, including those legally permitted, should not be brought to events.

You may also want to attend our Friday, June 13 We the People! No Kings! sign making workshop. Hours are from 10 - noon at the Meeting Hall at Honeyman Park (East Whoahink entrance.) Link is here to copy/paste into your browser https://www.mobilize.us/indivisible/event/792455/?referring_vol=1441071&rname=Darlene&share_context=event_details&share_medium=copy_link
accessibility_notes: The event is being held at a state park which meets ADA standards.

title: Rush-hour Resistance Rally @ ICE Field Office in Phoenix
description:
Big events with thousands of people are great. But we also need local, more frequent rallies that show locals that they're not alone in this fight.

**When we realized the DHS/ICE field office is in our neighborhood, we decided it would be the perfect place for an ICE-specific RhRR!**

Every Thursday @ 7:00 am, we'll gather on the south east corner of Central and Monte Vista, right in front of the ICE Field office.

**STAY ON THE SIDEWALK!** It's public property and we've a right to be there. Be sure you **DO NOT BLOCK** access to the building—that means cars as well as people.

**Please make ICE-specific signs**, as we're here to show the busy morning commuters that they are not alone and the ICE staffers that We The People care about due process for everyone.

Spread the word. Come join us. All the details you need are at [RhRR.us](https://rhrr.us/#museum-district).

Love this idea and want to start your own Rush-hour Resistance Rally in your area? Groovy! [Let's make that happen!](https://rhrr.us/#start-your-own)

title: No Kings: Let Freedom Fly - Brattleboro Indivisible
description:
No Kings! Let Freedom Fly in downtown Brattleboro on Flag Day! 

On Saturday, June 14, we’re taking to the streets again nationwide, standing together in love and unity. Our movement is building - to support justice, a sane society, a stronger world. We stand declaring that the power belongs with the people. That’s US! That’s each and every one of YOU! 

Come out and make some noise with us in Brattleboro! We’ll gather at Centre Congregational Church at 3:00 pm, parade with The People's Resistance Marching Band and Becky Graber’s street choir to end up on the Common. 

Once at the Common, protestors will be invited to engage with local groups and organizations at tables for information-sharing and grassroots strength building. You'll also be entertained by circus and street performers PLUS more music! We will celebrate the diversity that makes America shine! All flags welcome.

Together we call for justice, OUR Constitution to be upheld, and an end to executive overreach. We honor the flag of the United States, a symbol of freedom and national solidarity. We honor the rights of every person within its borders.

We are no longer interested in simply protesting the damage coming out of Washington, D.C., which affects every individual, we are here to stop it. As Martin Luther King Jr. said, "A time comes when silence is betrayal."  

We will not be silent, we will gather on the streets on June 14 and every day to follow in our neighborhoods, in collaboration. “The work of bringing people together in mutual recognition and cooperation is never really done”. --Archbishop Anthony Broglio

Co-hosted by Indivisible Brattleboro and Brattleboro Area Action, this partnership is bound by a shared commitment to nonviolence, inclusion, and democratic participation.

**This is intended as a family-friendly, safe, and peaceful protest.**

We are committed to complying fully with all town requests and guidelines, including:

* Remaining on the sidewalk at all times
* Following all traffic lights and pedestrian signals
* Respecting public safety personnel and instructions

This event is intended to be welcoming for all ages, inclusive, and non-disruptive. We believe in exercising our First Amendment rights with respect and responsibility, and we thank the community and local officials for their support in making this a safe gathering for everyone.

Let’s show up in solidarity and peace.
accessibility_notes:
**  Parking: **  Public street and lot parking is available in a number of locations in downtown Brattleboro; more information can be found here (https://brattleboro.gov/parking). The closest lots to the Church and Common are the town’s Grove and Harris lots, as well as the lot behind the church which belongs to the adjacent banks. There is also limited parking along Park Place immediately adjacent to the Common and a few spaces on an unpaved area right off of Putney Road at the Common. We ask you to keep both of these available for participants with limited mobility and to park as far away from the Common/Church as you feel comfortable walking so that participants with limited mobility are more likely to find close spots.

For folks with limited mobility, there are several private spots available in the Park Place parking lot. Please let us know ahead of time if you need to park here.

** Accessibility: **  The rally will start at the Centre Congregational Church and then we will march to the Common for the remainder of the rally. This walk is approximately .3 miles, is on sidewalks the entire way except for several marked street crossings, and includes some uphill and uneven sidewalks. If you have concerns about the route, you are welcome to meet us at the Common.

title: No Kings Day "Die-In" at Waterfront Park, Burlington
description:
NOTICE: As of 6/10 4pm we already have 165 people signed up!
We won't have a tombstone for everyone, so make and bring one if you can. Instructions below. If you can't, don't worry. Your body is what matters. Thanks.
-------------------------------------
As part of No Kings event at Burlington Waterfront, we will stage a Die-In to demonstrate the lethal impact of T**** administration budget, program cuts, foreign policy, immigration policy, attacks on our Democracy, and its very existence on people and programs, in the US and around the world.

We will silently march to the space in front of the main stage, and at the sound of a gong, we will lie down, sit, or remain standing, and be still and quiet  holding our tombstone signs. This will dramatize the actual health, safety, and life impacts the actions of the current administration is having on us and the world. After being still in silence for 3 minutes, we will rise and silently march to a nearby "graveyard" where we will plant our tombstones (they will have a small stake taped to them), to remain displayed for the rest of the day.

This type of protest was used effectively during the Vietnam war, the AIDS crisis, and five years ago at the birth of the Black Lives Matter movement. These have already been done in 2025 Utah and NYC at 50501 events. The photo above shows some of the 100 tombstones we've prepared already; the messages cover a broad range of what's under attack by Trump and MAGA Republicans. 

Make and bring your own if you can. We already have more than 165people signed up for our 120 tombstones. Please make them 30X20 inches, and for the message, write something that is an epitaph explaining what Trump/MAGA/GOP action is killing or has killed a person, program, institution, etc. See photo above for examples. "RIP Middle Class." "Starved, lost food stamps."  "RIP School Meals for our kids."  "Froze. Cuts to heating assistance."

More details, including  timing, meeting up, and recommended dress, will be emailed to you as the June 14 day-long event shapes up. 

This is a peaceful and silent protest.

title: Visibility Brigade - Share our message near Mall 205
description:
We gather weekly and show a message to passing cars on high visibility areas like freeway overpasses. You can bring your own signs but they're not required. We raise some larger Indivisible banners and spell out a short message in 2 foot tall letters. Then, we stand and wave at passing cars and chat about the movement and anything else. We stay about 2 hours, covering some high traffic time like rush hour. It's an easy and fun way to spread your message and meet fellow activists.

This week's will be at the Market Street overpass of I-205. You can park on Market street nearby and walk at most 2 blocks up a gentle hill.

title: NO KINGS Brattleboro
description:
**This is a march and rally.** 

- March starts at 3 p.m. sharp outside 193 Main St, Brattleboro, Vermont. 

- March goes south on Main Street, up Elliot Street. 

- After that, route TBD, ending at the Town Common with a rally.

**Let Freedom Fly!** in downtown Brattleboro on Flag Day from 3-6 pm. On Saturday, June 14, we’ll again join others nationwide, standing together in love and unity. Our movement for justice continues to build: We declare that power belongs with the people. That’s US! That’s each and every one of YOU!

Come out and make noise with us in Brattleboro! We’ll gather at Centre Congregational Church at 3:00 pm, 193 Main, parade with The Peoples Resistance Marching Band and Becky Graber’s Street Choir and end up on the Common.

There, neighbors can engage with local groups for information-sharing and grassroots strength-building. Cocina Lupita will bring their food truck with delicious Salvadorian food for sale. Mama T’s Sweet Shop will have desserts and we might be joined by another food truck. We’ll hear briefly from a few speakers and plan to have strolling musicians and other entertainment.

We will celebrate the diversity that makes America shine: bring your favorite flags--country, pride, issue or anything that shows who you are and what you love!

We honor the flag of the United States, a symbol of freedom and national solidarity. Together we demand that OUR Constitution be upheld, that the government respect the rule of law including the rights of every person within these borders.

As Martin Luther King Jr. said, "A time comes when silence is betrayal." We will not be silent, we will gather on the streets on June 14 and in our neighborhoods in collaboration, every day to follow. “The work of bringing people together in mutual recognition and cooperation is never really done”. --Archbishop Anthony Broglio

For more info, email BrattleboroAreaAction@proton.me

Co-hosted by Brattleboro Area Action and Indivisible Brattleboro, this partnership is bound by a shared commitment to nonviolence, inclusion, and democratic participation.

title: No Kings Montgomery County PA

location.venue: Montgomery County Courthouse Steps Swede St

description:
Peaceful Protest at Montgomery County Courthouse Steps on Swede Street. Bring your Megaphone, Bring your noisemakers, Bring your signs. Be creative! Stand up, Fight Back!!

Donald Trump thinks his rule is absolute, but in America, we don’t do “kings.” Since the inauguration, the Trump administration and its enablers have operated as though they have a mandate—but they don’t, and never did. They are going to extremes to empower Trump and enrich themselves, while cutting jobs and services for the rest of us. Now, they’re turning Flag Day into a celebration of Trump.

💰 He’s using OUR tax dollars to pay for HIS party: Donald Trump’s birthday celebration is expected to cost millions of our tax dollars, all while Republicans claim there’s no money for Social Security, SNAP, or Medicaid.

👑 We are united against kings: Trump has already indicated that he’s aiming for at least a third term, and now he’s planning a self-aggrandizing military parade in D.C But the American people don’t put up with kings. Together, we will mobilize in huge numbers to reject this corruption and abuse of power—it’s in our DNA as a country.

✋ They’ve gone too far: This is bigger than political disagreement. They’ve defied our courts, deported American citizens, disappeared people off the streets, and slashed our services—all while orchestrating a massive giveaway to their billionaire allies. Enough is enough. For anyone who thinks he’s gone too far, this movement is for you.

We’re standing together against the abuses of power, cruelty, and corruption. On June 14, we gather to remind Trump and his enablers: America has No King!

This event is being brought to you by all of the Montgomery County Indivisible Groups:

Indivisible Greater Jenkintown
Indivisible Lower Merion
Indivisible MontCo PA & Friends
Indivisible Narberth & Beyond
Indivisible Upper Merion
Social Justice Indivisible

title: NO KINGS in Jackson, Michigan!
description:
On June 14th, President Trump is planning a massive military parade. This is a show of force comparable to those in China, Russia, North Korea -- **Trump is intentionally emulating the acts of tyrants. And he's doing it with our money!** Tens of millions of dollars are going to this display of power while the Trump administration and DOGE keep cutting services that we need.

But real power doesn't lie in militant control. Real power comes from the American people. **Real power comes from us!** 

Trump and DOGE keep trying to control us. They defund community and cultural services that keep us informed and bring us together -- libraries, museums, education, student aid, radio, television, the arts. They strip away protections and programs that protect the Earth, threatening our natural resources. They pull back the regulations keeping us safe on the job. They cut our ability to retire without worry. They rob us of emergency funding. They take away our Medicaid and CDC funding to put us in danger. 

And when we speak out? They punish us by kidnapping random people off the streets and sending them to suffer inhumane conditions -- deporting regardless of innocence or legal status. They block judges' ability to keep them in check. They even make it more and more difficult for us to vote!

These are the acts of a ruler trying to keep the people in check. **It's time for us to remind Trump that the U.S. is a democracy, not a monarchy.** Donald Trump is not a king!

NO KINGS!

June 14th, Withington Park, downtown Jackson MI. Come rally with us! 
Come when you can! **All are welcome!**

---
If your group is interested in attending or speaking at the protest, please contact organizer Ella Scott at ellascott41637@gmail.com to give a quick heads-up! We'd be happy to have you!

Please visit the information table when you arrive! Thank you!

RECOMMENDATION: Bring a sign related to the "No Kings" theme discussed above. You may want to bring a chair. Dress for the weather: it looks like it's going to be hot and humid. Bring water!

WARNING FOR ATTENDEES: Please don't park in the Sew and Sew parking lot; you will be towed. Instead, park Tim Walberg's lot, the bank parking lot, or in the old Crossfit lot.

title: Ashburnham Stands Up! - NO KINGS DAY!
description:
Date: June 14, 2025 
Location: In Front of Ashburnham Town Hall 
Time: 10:00-11:30 am. 
(Please note: We must stay on the sidewalk.)
 
About this event. 

On April 19, 1775, we rejected being ruled by a King. Today, we reject being ruled by a wannabe King.  Let’s come together for a peaceful demonstration and stand up for our rights and the rights of those being silenced.  Make your voice heard!  We will not accept injustice and tyranny in our democracy. 
 
In America, we don’t do Kings. June 14, 2025, “NO KINGS” is a national day of action and mass mobilization in response to increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption from Trump and his allies.  We've watched as they've cracked down on free speech, detained people for their political views, deported children who are American citizens, and defied the courts. They've done this all while continuing to serve and enrich their billionaire allies and themselves. 
 
On Saturday, June 14, Flag Day and the 250th Anniversary of the Armed Forces, we’re joining hundreds of protests nationwide to build a movement that leaves Trump behind. 
 
A core principle behind all NO KINGS events is a commitment to nonviolent action.  We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values. 
 
Let’s defend Democracy, the rule of law, and our Republic -together!

title: NO KINGS RALLY - MORRISTOWN
description:
📢 📢 Morristown Town Hall, 200 South St.📢 
11:00 AM - 12:30 PM
📢 Large crowds are expected. 📢 Carpool, use a ride share or public transportation. 📢 Stay together. 📢 Bring a fully charged phone; disable location services . 📢 There will be NO seating or public bathrooms. 📢 
Dress appropriately for the weather. 📢 Wear sunscreen and avoid umbrellas. 📢 Bring water. 

Please help to defray the expenses for this rally by making a contribution of any amount at https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcdcnokings

If you are interested in volunteering, please sign up here in addition to registering for the event: https://forms.gle/p2PKfMsKQ3SFxaHz6  

*WHAT IS “NO KINGS”?*

NO KINGS is a national day of action and mass mobilization in response to the increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption of the Trump administration. We’ve watched as they’ve cracked down on free speech, detained people for their political positions, threatened to deport American citizens, and defied the courts. They’ve done this all while continuing to serve and enrich their billionaire allies. They think they rule—but we are bigger than even their worst aspirations.


*****PLEASE PARK LEGALLY and obey all signs. Parking will be a challenge, Carpool, rideshare, or use public transportation. There are several public parking lots in Morristown, including the lot behind Town Hall on Franklin St. DO NOT park in the Kings shopping lot. 
For your safety, cross only at crosswalks. South Street is a busy road. *
. 
📢 📢 Remember, this is a PEACEFUL protest; do not engage with counter protestors or agitators. 📢 📢 

Be respectful and dispose of any trash properly before leaving the rally; keep Morristown beautiful!!

📢 📢 📢 On June 14th, join us as we show up where he isn’t—to say no thrones, no crowns, NO KINGS! Bring your signs and your voice and meet us at 200 South Street in Morristown at 11:00 AM. We'll have music and speakers and will remind the world what democracy really looks like. 

📢 📢 📢 June 14th isn't about Donald Trump. It is Flag Day and the flag belongs to us.  NO KINGS Morristown is hosted by the Morris County Democratic Committee, Planned Parenthood Action Fund of NJ, NJ 11th for Change and New Jersey Citizen Action.

No Kings is a nationwide day of defiance. From city blocks to small towns, from courthouse steps to community parks, we’re taking action to reject authoritarianism. We’re not gathering to feed his ego. We’re building a movement that leaves him behind.

A core principle behind all No Kings events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values and to act lawfully at these events. Weapons of any kind should not be brought to events.

location.venue: York steps next to US Embassy

description:
**We don't put up with mad tyrants.**

NO TYRANTS is an international day of action and mass mobilization in response to increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption from Trump and his allies. We’ve watched as they’ve cracked down on free speech, detained people for their political views, threatened to deport American citizens, and defied the courts. They’ve done this all while continuing to serve and enrich their billionaire allies.

On June 14—Flag Day in the US—Donald Trump wants tanks in the street and a made-for-TV display of dominance for his birthday. A spectacle meant to look like strength. But real power isn’t staged in Washington. It rises up everywhere else.

**On Saturday, June 14, we’re taking to the streets internationally. We’re not gathering to feed his ego. We’re building a movement that leaves him behind.**

On June 14, Indivisible Ottawa is STANDING UP and saying NO TYRANTS in solidarity with Indivisible Abroad, Democrats Abroad, concerned Canadians and allies around the world.
.
The flag doesn’t belong to Donald Trump. On June 14th, we’re showing up everywhere he isn’t—to say no tyrants, no dictators, no oligarchs.

**PLEASE NOTE** In Canada, we have a king who serves as head of state. So we are NOT using the "No Kings" language of other events, and we ask you NOT to bring signs with that phrase. 

We're swapping "No Crowns" for "No Clowns!" We encourage everyone to come dressed as Tr*mp clowns (or one of his cronies.) Think bad blonde wig, orange face, long red tie, and get creative!

A core principle behind all No Kings/No Tyrants events is a commitmen to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values.

title: NO KINGS Leland, NC | Indivisible

location.venue: Intersection of Olde Waterford Way & Route 17 Southbound

description:
**In America, we don’t put up with would-be kings.**

NO KINGS is a national day of action and mass mobilization in response to increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption from Trump and his allies. They’ve defied our courts, deported Americans, disappeared people off the streets, attacked our civil rights, and slashed our services. 

🚨**On June 14th, we’re showing up to say no thrones, no crowns, no kings.**🚨

This event is hosted by Indivisible Defenders of Democracy (Brunswick County), Indivisible Wilmington, and Brunswick Indivisible Stepping Forward for Action.

Join us at the intersection of Olde Waterford Way and Route 17 Southbound between the hours of 11:00 AM and 1:00 PM. 

Rain or shine, we will stand on the grass near this high-traffic intersection. Our job is to be visible. Our aim is to be respectful, safe, and considerate of passing motorists.

**Please park in the public parking areas near the Harris Teeter at 2021 Olde Regent Way, Leland, NC 28451. From there, it is a 5-minute walk to the intersection of Olde Waterford Way and Route 17 Southbound. Look for the Wells Fargo Bank on the corner.**

BRING: Big, legible signs with messages related to the No Kings theme. American flags. A backpack with food and water, sunscreen, sunglasses, a hat, an umbrella. Feel free to bring a chair to sit a spell if you get tired. 

*A core principle behind all No Kings events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values.*

Please Note: There is a NO KINGS Rally in Wilmington at Innes Park (102 N. 3rd St.) from 12:00 PM - 1:30 PM hosted by Women Organizing for Wilmington. We encourage you to attend whichever is most convenient– or both, if you're feeling ambitious!

Check out nokings.org for more information.
accessibility_notes:
Parking lots are within walking distance. There is a Wells Fargo bank on this corner that is closed on Saturdays and usually has 20 to 30 open parking spots. We suggest that those with mobility needs park in this lot. We will have volunteers ready to assist you. 

To access the picket site, it's a short walk in the grass on mostly even ground. Unfortunately, this path is not wheelchair accessible. If you'd like to see photos and video of the terrain ahead of time, please send us a message by Friday, June 13th.

There are some shade trees where you can step out of the sun to rest. We will have chairs set up in the shade for those who wish to take a break.  

There are many retail establishments within close walking distance where you can make use of restrooms.

title: 💥💫INDEPENDENCE DAY:💫💥 MEANS SHOWING UP 🔥  JUL 4 & 5 - Santa Clarita, SCV

address_lines: Corner of McBean Blvd. and Valencia Blvd.

description:
🔥 VISIBILITY PROTEST — INDEPENDENCE MEANS SHOWING UP 🔥 - 

📅 Friday, July 4th | 🕥 7:30 PM–9:00 PM | 📍 Good Trouble Corner (Valencia Blvd. & McBean Pkwy)

 🎉 Freedom & Democracy Protest — Join us as we raise our voices alongside the City of Santa Clarita’s anticipated annual Fourth of July Fireworks Show! 🎆 As the sky lights up over Valencia Town Center, we’ll stand together in purpose and celebration — reminding our community that Independence Day is not just about fireworks, but about defending the values that make democracy real. 

Let’s close out the holiday with joy, unity, and a clear message: we’ll have a Republic — if we can keep it.  🎉

☀️ DOUBLE THE GOOD TROUBLE ☀️ - Make your voices be heard.


📅 Saturday, July 5th | 🕥 10:00 AM–12:00 PM | 📍 Good Trouble Corner (Valencia Blvd. & McBean Pkwy)

Join Indivisible CA27 for a powerful Independence and post–Independence Day visibility protests as we reclaim the meaning of freedom, democracy, and justice in America.  Pride in our FLAG, proud to be FREE.  ☀️ Before it gets too hot!!! ☀️

Right before the fireworks or While the fireworks fade the next day, our message will rise: real independence means defending everyone’s rights — voting rights, reproductive freedom, LGBTQ+ dignity, climate justice, immigrant protections, and civil liberties for all.

We’ll gather twice at the iconic Good Trouble Corner with signs, flags, messages of resistance, and community spirit. These are peaceful, high-visibility actions — bring your energy, water, sunscreen, and a sign that speaks your truth.

Whether you’ve been with us before or this is your first time, your voice belongs here. Let’s remind our community that patriotism means participation — and freedom means showing up.

📣 All are welcome. Bring a friend. Bring your voice.

Let’s make democracy visible.

title: Independence Day Resistance Rally - Indivisible - Democracy Action Network
description:
"No Kings Since 1776" - Standing Against Autocracy

Join us on July 5th for a peaceful march and rally to reaffirm our commitment to democratic principles and stand against the threats of autocracy. As we gather just after Independence Day, we honor our founders' revolutionary spirit and their rejection of monarchical rule.

Why July 5th?

While the nation celebrates on the 4th, we gather the day after to remind ourselves that independence isn't just a historical achievement—it's an ongoing responsibility. Just as the revolutionaries of 1776 declared "No More Kings," we continue their legacy by standing vigilant against autocratic tendencies in our own time.

What to Bring:

- Signs (suggested themes: democratic values, checks and balances, "No Kings Since 1776")
- Water and sun protection
- Your commitment to peaceful democratic action

This non-partisan event welcomes all who believe in preserving democratic institutions and opposing autocratic governance, regardless of political affiliation.

title: No Kings Nationwide Day of Defiance
description:
On June 14th—Flag Day—Trump is staging a $50 million military parade in D.C., complete with tanks, warplanes, and thousands of troops. While MAGA shows off raw power, they’re slashing Medicaid, food assistance, and other life-saving services. It’s a spectacle meant to intimidate—but we won’t be silent.

Join local Indivisible groups in Portland for NO KINGS—a national day of defiance against authoritarianism and far-right extremism.

We’ll rally at Salmon Street Springs in Portland with music, performers, and powerful voices. From civil rights to antiwar movements, music has always fueled resistance and brought communities together in protest. After the rally, we’ll take that spirit and join the marchers as they leave the waterfront.

This is a peaceful, nonviolent protest—one rooted in hope, solidarity, and the power of collective action.

NO KINGS IN AMERICA.

title: Wheeler Salmonberry Trail Ground Building
description:
**Join The Salmonberry Trail in our exciting ground breaking event at Waterfront Park in Wheeler!**

The City of Wheeler is excited to announce that we are taking the first steps toward revitalization of Wheeler’s section of the Salmonberry Trail through partnership with the Salmonberry Trail Foundation and Tillamook Coast Visitors Association. We will be holding a **Ground Building event and ceremony on July 12, 2025 from 1:00-5:00 PM.** We truly could not be more excited for the recreational opportunities this trail will provide for our community.

This transformative project holds the potential to deliver lasting, meaningful benefits to our community. By linking the Willamette Valley to the Coast, it will not only strengthen regional connectivity but also invigorate rural tourism and empower small businesses. It champions public health and safe, active transportation options while expanding equitable access to the outdoors for all residents. Most importantly, it lays the foundation for sustainable infrastructure that will support our economy, environment, and quality of life for generations to come.

We will have local vendors, music, games, and a ribbon cutting ceremony celebrating the beginning of this coastal section of the trail. 
- July 12th, 1PM - 5PM
- Waterfront Park (500 Marine Dr, Wheeler, OR 97147)

---
**ABOUT THE SALMONBERRY TRAIL**
The Salmonberry Trail is an 82-mile multi-use path transforming a historic rail line into Oregon’s next big adventure. Connecting communities from the Willamette Valley to the coast, the trail will provide safe routes for recreation and education, expand economic opportunities, and improve public health. In partnership with local organizations, it will offer unique educational programs while promoting outdoor activity and conservation, making it a cornerstone of community development and environmental stewardship across the state.

**Wheeler Demonstration Project – Salmonberry Trail**
The Wheeler Demonstration Project is a short, high-impact segment of the Salmonberry Trail located in downtown Wheeler. This 1,800-foot trail segment runs north from Rector Street, across Hemlock Street, and along the bay side of the Oregon Coast Scenic Railway tracks adjacent to Botts Marsh. It features a compacted gravel path for pedestrians, designed to enhance safety and encourage walking in the downtown area.
Developed in partnership with the City of Wheeler, Oregon Coast Scenic Railway, Lower Nehalem Community Trust, and the Salmonberry Trail Foundation, the project supports local economic activity, offers environmental education through interpretive signage, and provides a model for similar efforts in other communities along the trail corridor.

title: Weekly Rally at Orange Plaza Square Park - When We Unite, We Win!
description:
**Come to the Orange Plaza Square Park each week**, rain or shine, to take a stand opposing the oligarchs, billionaires and the regime that's attacking our way of life and the Constitution of the USA. Join our community in a nonviolent, peaceful demonstration! Make your voice heard. We are the many, they are the few that want to rule us all. Take a stand for democracy. Bring your signs, bring pots and pans, your whistles and kazoos and meet at the fountain - we'll spread out from there after a safety briefing. Let the people be heard! Let’s make some noise!

**GENERAL PROTEST/RALLY REMINDERS**

Remember the ABCs of protesting:

A) Always obey traffic signals and directions of the safety team!

B) Beware of detractors*! Do not talk to detractors or unaffiliated interviewers - doing so increases risks for all of us, including all the volunteers and organizers.

C) Chill vibes please! Never touch anyone else or their property (e.g., car, sign, backpack) without permission. Have fun! Build community!

*As our events become more popular, we may attract detractors and Trump/Elon/MAGA supporters, either passing in cars or as rally attendees. Some of their tactics are to act friendly, ask questions, and pretend to care about your answers. They may also gesture, yell, name-call, and use foul language. They often look to get a reaction they can capture on video. Do NOT engage with or speak to them. Do NOT answer their questions. Do NOT yell back at them or gesture (thumbs down, middle finger, etc.) Do NOT post photos or videos of them online. Do NOT reveal any personal or contact info to anyone at this or any rally you do not know to be on your side. If someone becomes threatening or violent, move away quickly and alert a safety volunteer, a police officer, and/or call 911. These guidelines keep you, our volunteers, and our organizers safe. Thank you!

**[Learn to de-escalate](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_Pgmn9QRr48&list=PLqIrQkVlKU3RZw0ytVd3U7XS3ofAaZItu&index=2)**

**[Learn to Grey-rock](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/grey-rock-method)**

**MEET YOUR HOST**

**[Indivisible CA 40](https://linktr.ee/indivisibleca40)** is a non-partisan, all volunteer grassroots group of residents in the CA-40 congressional district who are holding elected officials accountable, from city councils and school boards all the way up to Congress. We partner with other community organizations to uplift and support our neighbors while we work toward electoral change in 2026.

title: NO KINGS Douglas County, Colorado

location.venue: Douglas County Fairgrounds and Event Center

description:
**In America, we don’t put up with would-be kings.** 

Douglas County, we're joining the **NO KINGS National Day of Action** to make our collective voices heard in protest of the increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption from Trump and his allies. (And, yes, that includes the little wanna-be kings right here in DougCo, too!!) 

We’re not putting up with a crackdown on free speech, detainment of people for their political views, threats to deport American citizens, and open defiance of the courts. And we're not putting up with the sneaky Home Rule power grab here in our home county, either. 

## Why June 14th?

It’s many things. It’s Flag Day. It’s the US Army’s 250th birthday. And it’s Donald Trump’s birthday. And he’s of course using the Army’s birthday as an excuse to throw himself a military parade for a birthday party, like a real dictator. 

The flag doesn’t belong to Donald Trump. It belongs to us. We’re not watching history happen. We’re making it.

**On June 14th, we’re showing up everywhere to say, "no thrones, no crowns, no kings."**

Check out nokings.org for more information.

## Event Details

What: Douglas County NO KINGS Protest and March

Where: E Plum Creek Pkwy (East of I25) in Castle Rock

When: 2:30pm-4:30pm on Saturday, June 14, 2025

## Specifics

- **Parking and Arrival**: Parking will be at the Douglas County Fairgrounds upper parking lot (the lot closest to Plum Creek). Please plan to arrive to park **no earlier than 2pm**. Recommended arrival between 2:15pm-2:30pm. _Carpooling is highly recommended as much as possible!! There are just over 440 parking spaces in the Fairgrounds upper lot, and we are hoping for 1,000+ attendees! If necessary, there are multiple public parking lots and public parking garages in downtown Castle Rock that attendees can use if we do fill up the Fairgrounds upper lot._

- **Protest** will be held from 2:30pm-3:00pm on the _public sidewalks_ along Plum Creek, between the Fairgrounds and S Perry St. 

- **March** will start at 3:00pm and will go on the _public sidewalks_ down Perry St. to Festival Park. Through Festival Park to S Wilcox St, and back up S Wilcox St on _public sidewalks_ to E Plum Creek Pkwy, and back to the Fairgrounds upper parking lot. 

- We **cannot** block any public right-of-way, including the sidewalks and roads. We **must** use crosswalks. We **must** stay on the sidewalks. 

- **Please note for anyone with mobility concerns or anyone otherwise unable to join in the March:** the March is optional! You are welcome to stay just on the sidewalks along Plum Creek for the entire event. The upper parking lot that we will be using for parking at the Fairgrounds is very close to Plum Creek, so you can minimize walking. For those that can't stand for that amount of time, bring your camping/folding chairs and sit in the grass beside the sidewalks (so as not to block the sidewalks). 

- The yearly Castle Rock Classic Car Show will be in downtown Castle Rock on the same day, but will likely be wrapping up by the time we are marching. title: NO KINGS BROOKLINE RALLY FOR DEMOCRACY
description:
🚨 June 14th marks Donald Trump’s birthday—and this year, it also marks a dangerous display of authoritarian ambition: a taxpayer-funded military parade in Washington, D.C., costing tens of millions of dollars.  Across the country, people are standing up to say: No Kings!

🚨 We are against tyranny, corruption, racism, hatred, lies, violence, and threats to our democracy.

🚨 We are for justice, free speech, the rule of law, immigrants’ rights, civil rights, healthcare, education, science, climate action, and a government that serves all the people—not just the powerful. 

🚨 We believe democracy depends on all of us—standing together, speaking out, and showing up.  Bring your friends, your signs, your voice, and your commitment to a country where no one is above the law—and where we the people are the ones who hold power.

🚨 No thrones. No tyrants. No silence. No kings! 🚨

title: NO KINGS! "We the People" Parade Palo Alto
description:
What are you doing on Flag Day? Donald Trump will be conducting a militaristic charade. We will be hosting a peaceful parade. 

On June 14, we will hold a peaceful gathering that sends a bracing message to Trump and his MAGA minions: *This is what an American parade looks like.* No tanks, no guns, no war planes. Instead, there will be costumes, music, and American flags. It will be a sidewalk procession of your friends and neighbors—and you. We ARE the parade.
 
In Washington, D.C., Trump will oversee a military display that echoes the aggressive pretensions of dictators overseas. His self-serving event will shamefully contradict the spirit of the democratic republic for which our flag stands.

In Palo Alto, as elsewhere across the country, Americans will rise up to celebrate our liberation from kingly pretension. We will gather not just in protest, but in defiance—loud, proud, joyful defiance of a tinpot wannabe tyrant who thinks that celebrating his birthday matters more than honoring the flag that symbolizes our freedom.

This event—jointly hosted by Indivisible Mid-Peninsula, Indivisible Palo Alto Plus, and Indivisible Portola Valley, and cosponsored by Bend the Arc, Menlo Park Speaks out, and It’s Blue Turn—will celebrate patriotism, not militarism. *In saying NO to kings, we will also say YES to democracy.*

The parade will be a sidewalk march. It will start at the intersection of El Camino Real and Embarcadero Road, in Palo Alto, and continue on the sidewalk along Embarcadero before ending at Rinconada Park. We invite participants to join us at any point along the 1.5-mile route. 

After the parade, at Rinconada Park, we will host a democracy fair that starts at 3 p.m. Please sign up for that event as well. https://www.mobilize.us/nokings/event/792518/

The parade will be a peaceful, nonviolent event, with no tolerance for any kind of conflict or altercation. We will show respect for property owners at all points along the parade route and will comply with any requests by police.

Please Note: Attendees or professional photographers may take photos at the event. If you prefer not to have your image captured or shared, please take precautions (such as by wearing a mask, hat, or wig).

title: Friday Rally to Protect Democracy in Mentor
description:
Come on over to Eleanor Garfield Park in Mentor every Friday from 10-11:30am.  Join us for a weekly rally to protect democracy. 

We will stand along Mentor Avenue with signs and flags. We will peacefully show that we object to the insidious cuts to vital federal programs and employees, the abduction of immigrants, and the racist policies conducted by the Trump administration.

District 14 members will have the opportunity to fill out comment sheets for Congressman Dave Joyce.

Bring signs, friends, and family.   Bring family-friendly signs.  

Each week we will donate food to a local food bank. Please bring canned protein, whole grains, pasta, cereal, peanut butter and jam, and toilet paper, paper towels, and tissues.   Please check the expiration dates on food, and please do not bring expired items.  Legally, food pantries cannot accept expired food.

Please park in the lower lot if you are able to make the walk up to the event site.   Please keep the spaces in the upper lot open for those who need a shorter walk.  

This event is sponsored by Ohio District 14 Partners in collaboration with the pro-democracy groups in Ohio's District 14. 

Note—this event was formerly titled ‘Where’s Congressman Joyce.” Though the title has changed, we still wonder where he is, and why he is not answering our specific concerns.

title: Flags Up! No Kings!
description:
**Saturday, June 14th (Flag Day)**, let us honor the true spirit of America: a nation where power belongs to the people, not to any single individual. Here in Ames, we invite all who cherish 'liberty and justice for ALL' to gather with us. Together, our voices will rise to defend our democracy and the enduring promise of freedom.

Join **Indivisible Ames** and **Democracy Every Day** for this vital community observance! To help share our patriotic spirit, we'll have **free American flags for participants** (limited numbers, so please come early to our main gathering!).

If you wish to **Volunteer** please contact *IndivisibleAmes@proton.me*

We are uniting as part of the **"No Kings" Nationwide Day of Defiance** to send an unmistakable message:

* No one is above the law.
* We demand accountability and cherish the rule of law.
* We will not stand idly by while our hard-won democratic freedoms – freedoms for everyone – are undermined.

### Here's what we're planning at Roosevelt Park (10:00 AM - 11:30 AM):

* **Gather & Connect (10:00 AM):** Meet us at **Roosevelt Park** for our main Flag Day morning gathering.

* **Inspiring Speakers:** Hear from passionate local voices and community leaders who are dedicated to protecting our democracy and advancing justice.
* ***Kate Gregory***
    * United States Navy Veteran
* ***Susan Benner***
    * Immigration Advocate
* ***Aaron Lehman***
    * Local Farmer - President, Iowa Farmers Union
* ***Doug Fuller***
    * Local Farmer - Member, Iowa Farmers Union
* *(More speakers to be announced!)*


**Optional Activity Following the Main Gathering:**

* **Flags Up! Mobile Sign Brigade (After Main Rally):** For those who wish to continue making our voices visible, an informal Mobile Sign Brigade will head out along Grand Ave. after our main program concludes. This is a great, energetic way to take our **"Flags Up! No Kings!"** message further into the community. Participation is optional – join if you're able!

## Why This Matters Right Now:

Our democratic republic, and the freedoms it promises, are not spectator sports; they require our active participation and unwavering defense from all of us. This Flag Day, let's demonstrate our collective strength, our resolve, and our commitment to a future where everyone's rights are protected, every voice matters, and the promise of American liberty is made real for all.

**RSVP now** to join **Indivisible Ames** and **Democracy Every Day** for **"Flags Up! No Kings!"** Be part of this crucial national day of action and let's send a clear message: **No Kings in America!**


## Guidelines for Rally Participants

### Our Approach: Be Respectful & Effective
Remember, a message delivered respectfully and without confrontation has the best chance of being heard. Always be polite and respectful, even to those who might disagree or try to engage negatively.
* *Do not engage in arguments. If someone yells at you from traffic, remember Michelle Obama's advice: "When they go low, we go high."*

### Safety First: Stick Together & Stay Aware
Never participate alone. For safety, always ensure you are with at least one other person. If you find yourself alone, call a friend to join you or return another day. Trust your instincts. If any interaction makes you feel uncomfortable or unsafe, disengage immediately, leave the area, and call the police if needed.

### Location & Conduct: Be Safe & Legal
Stay on public sidewalks or within the park. This is vital for everyone's safety (yours and drivers'), ensures pedestrians can pass (step into the park grass to let them by), and keeps us on legal public property. Public property includes sidewalks, the grassy area between the street and sidewalk (right-of-way), and city parks. Do not enter private property.
* *Keep yourself and your signs out of the street. Do not stand in the road or wave signs into traffic lanes.*
accessibility_notes: Roosevelt Park is generally accessible. The Mobile Sign Brigade will be along a public street. Please contact us via Mobilize or Indivisible Ames if you have specific accessibility questions or needs.

On June 14—Flag Day—Donald Trump wants tanks in the street and a made-for-TV display of dominance for his birthday. A spectacle meant to look like strength. But real power isn’t staged in Washington. It rises up everywhere else.

No Kings is a nationwide day of defiance on June 14.  We are taking action in Laramie to reject authoritarianism with our No Crowns No Clowns protest and march.  

We’re not gathering to feed his ego. We’re building a movement that leaves him behind. The flag doesn’t belong to Donald Trump. It belongs to us. We’re not watching history happen. We’re making it.

On June 14th, we’re showing up to say no kings, no thrones, no crowns, no clowns!


A note about dogs at these events.  We love dogs and many of us have dogs.  But protests and marches can be scary for dogs with crowds of strangers and lots of unfamiliar noises from speeding traffic, coal-rolling, chanting, and speakers.  The recommendation is to leave our beloved furry friends safe at home where they will greet us with their unconditional love when we return.

A note about non-violence.  A core principle behind all 50501 events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values and to act lawfully at these events. Weapons of any kind, including those legally permitted, should not be brought to events.

This event is hosted by 50501 Wyoming and sponsored by the Albany County Democrats.  Many thanks to Ashley Brown for the graphic!
